queries.initial_sql:

  m.label, 
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.element) AS elements
FROM 
  molecule m
JOIN 
  atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
  connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN 
  bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_type = '#' 
GROUP BY 
  m.label;
queries.final_sql:
SELECT 
  m.label, 
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.element) AS elements
FROM 
  molecule m
JOIN 
  atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
  connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN 
  bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_type = '#' 
GROUP BY 
  m.label;

queries.initial_sql:
SELECT s.Virtual, s.School, s.County, s.District, s.CDSCode, s.SchoolName, s.DistrictName, s.CountyName, s.AvgScrRead
FROM (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.SchoolName, s.DistrictName, s.CountyName, s.AvgScrRead,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC) AS RN
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.Virtual = 'F'
) AS subquery
JOIN schools sc ON subquery.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
WHERE RN <= 5
ORDER BY subquery.County, subquery.AvgScrRead DESC;
queries.final_sql:
SELECT s.Virtual, s.School, s.County, s.District, s.CDSCode, s.SchoolName, s.DistrictName, s.CountyName, s.AvgScrRead
FROM (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.SchoolName, s.DistrictName, s.CountyName, s.AvgScrRead,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC) AS RN
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.Virtual = 'F'
) AS subquery
JOIN schools sc ON subquery.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
WHERE RN <= 5
ORDER BY subquery.County, subquery.AvgScrRead DESC;
